name: Khurma
instructions: 1. Mix maida with melted ghee and enough water to form a tight, stiff dough.
2. Rest the dough for 30 minutes, then roll it out into a thick sheet.
3. Cut the sheet into small uniform bite-sized squares or diamonds.
4. Heat oil/ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan and deep-fry the pieces on medium-low heat until golden and crispy.
5. Prepare a thick sugar syrup of one-string consistency and infuse with cardamom powder.
6. Toss the fried khurma in the sugar syrup until coated and allow them to cool and crystallize.
description: Khurma is a beloved traditional snack in Madhya Pradesh, often prepared during festivals like Diwali and weddings. It is a crisp, sweet treat that reflects the region's penchant for long-lasting, shelf-stable celebratory sweets.
